description: T15190_熊本市消防局管内における火災等の状況(火災件数、損害額等) [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本市. 熊本市消防局管内における火災等の状況（火災件数、損害額等）の推移 ※2011年1月～2021年12月の各月間値 ※出典は『熊本市統計書』と記載して下さい。 ※以下の通り管轄の再編（広域化等）が行われています。 平成 26 年 4 月 1 日：宇城広域連合から脱退し、旧下益城郡富合町及び旧下益城郡城南町の区域を管轄 平成 26 年 4 月... Coverage: 熊本市. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本市. Its tags are 消防, 火災, 熊本市統計書, 統計情報. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
